implementation: Approximate raw OSD plane 2 first-region measurements; preserves stock firmware algorithm and SPI output.
descriptor_basis: Same observed format-14 descriptor and byte selectors as philips-osd.inc, recovered from shipped driver.
sampling: 32×20 cells; 4×4 uniformly spaced samples per cell; averaged 8-bit RGB shifted left eight bits.
bounds: 32-bit address range checked; all reads through RAM-only callback.
At most 81 reads per frame, maximum read size 16,384 bytes.
Frame atomically committed after all reads; QEMU invalid-source fallback is zero measurements.

coverage: late RAM read failure leaves output unchanged
tests.qemu_integration: Passed against qemu-amb-framebuffer; see qtest-measure-framebuffer.json. Verified actual guest RAM descriptor, byte selectors, register output, stable frame snapshot, next-frame bitmap change, default-off mode and shared IRQ regressions.

limitations: Approximates hardware measurement filter; not calibrated physical input.
Samples raw first OSD region only; no video-plane composition, scaling, mirror, flip, cropping, or additional regions.
Synthetic geometry remains; no measured physical LED ordering.
